headline.title: SpaceXAI releases Grok 4.5, which Elon describes as an ‘Opus-class model’
headline.summary: SpaceXAI has launched Grok 4.5, which Elon Musk characterizes as an 'Opus-class model,' offering a more cost-effective and efficient option compared to existing AI models. The release aims to enhance accessibility and performance in AI technology.

articles.title: Helping K–12 educators build practical AI skills
articles.summary: OpenAI Academy, in partnership with the Walton Family Foundation, is launching hands-on AI Skills Jams aimed at equipping K–12 educators with practical AI skills for classroom integration. The initiative seeks to enhance educators' understanding and application of AI technologies in their teaching practices.

articles.title: Prime Intellect raises $130M Series A to help enterprises build their own AI agents
articles.summary: Prime Intellect has secured $130 million in Series A funding to empower enterprises to develop their own AI agents independently. Founded in 2024, the company aims to provide organizations with the tools necessary for training agentic systems without dependence on major AI laboratories.

articles.title: I Built a Self-Improving AI, and So Can You
articles.summary: The article discusses the author's experience in creating a self-improving AI, emphasizing that advancements in AI development are accessible beyond major research institutions. It encourages individuals to engage in AI experimentation and development, highlighting the potential for broader participation in the field.

articles.title: Google Photos adds a new AI ‘Video Remix’ tool
articles.summary: Google Photos has introduced a new AI-powered 'Video Remix' tool that enhances videos by applying cinematic relighting, changing backgrounds, and adding artistic styles. This feature aims to improve the overall visual appeal of users' video clips.

articles.title: Notes on technical alignment via human-like social drives
articles.summary: The article explores the technical alignment problem for future brain-like AGI, emphasizing the importance of human social and moral drives as a foundation for alignment strategies. It suggests that leveraging these innate human characteristics could help ensure that AGIs act in ways that promote a positive future.

articles.title: ChatGPT’s upgraded voice mode is better at shutting up
articles.summary: OpenAI has introduced an upgraded voice mode for ChatGPT, featuring the new GPT-Live-1 model, which aims to improve conversational flow by reducing interruptions and allowing for pauses. The enhancements are intended to create a more natural interaction experience, resembling a conversation with another person.

articles.title: Meta wants its AI glasses to seem less creepy. Its AI strategy says otherwise.
articles.summary: Meta is implementing a new safeguard for its AI glasses to prevent unauthorized recording of individuals. This update contrasts with the company's ongoing expansion of data collection practices for its AI products.

articles.title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
articles.summary: OpenAI's recent analysis highlights significant reliability and accuracy issues in SWE-Bench Pro, a widely used coding benchmark for evaluating AI models. The findings suggest that the benchmark may not effectively separate meaningful performance signals from noise.

articles.title: This startup thinks robotics is about to have its ChatGPT moment
articles.summary: Startup General Intuition aims to leverage millions of hours of video game data to train foundation models for physical AI, potentially revolutionizing robotics by reducing the need for extensive real-world data. The company believes this approach could lead to smarter and more efficient robots.

articles.title: Your gaming data could be the secret to AGI, according to this Bezos-backed startup
articles.summary: A startup backed by Jeff Bezos, General Intuition, is exploring the potential of gaming data to bridge the gap in capabilities of large language models, which struggle with understanding spatial and temporal dynamics essential for achieving artificial general intelligence (AGI). The company believes that leveraging this type of data could enhance the development of more generalized AI systems.

articles.title: Why this CEO thinks video games make better training data than the internet
articles.summary: The CEO of General Intuition argues that video games provide superior training data for achieving artificial general intelligence (AGI) compared to traditional internet sources. This is due to video games' ability to simulate real-world physics and interactions, which are crucial for developing models that can understand movement and spatial relationships.
